snippet.title: King's Quest 4 Official Trailer SCI 1989
snippet.description:
Official trailer for King's Quest IV: The Perils of Rosella (SCI version) from August 1989.

Back then these promo clips were called "non-playable demo" or "non-interactive demo" and came in form of exexutable files utilizing the game engine, there purpose however were those of trailers promoting the game.

#ludophiles #ludophilia #gametrailer #retrogaming #kingsquest #sierra
